summary: 过去 24 小时 AI 新闻按技术、模型、商业、投资、安全与监管聚合。页面优先展示影响力高、来源清晰、并且能解释后续产业意义的信号。

keylines.title: 大模型是今日主轴
keylines.text: 过去 24 小时里，大模型相关内容占比最高，说明媒体报道和社交讨论正在向这一方向集中。

keylines.title: Grok / xAI带动 X 讨论
keylines.text: X 热点更偏实时体验和争议观点，适合用来捕捉模型、产品和安全事件的早期信号。

keylines.title: 基础设施仍是深层变量
keylines.text: 芯片、数据中心、电力和推理成本会持续决定 AI 产品能否从发布会走向规模化商业。

stories.title: Anthropic is operating a lab that conducts biology experiments
stories.summary: AI leaders have been promising that AI is the key to curing human disease. Anthropic researchers have also been warning that AI might kill us all.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于技术路线信号，后续重点是可复现性、工程成本和是否能被开源或商业系统快速吸收。

stories.title: AI hallucination nearly triggers US military operation
stories.summary: “It’s important for service members to understand the uncertainty inherent to LLMs," a GovAI research scholar warns.
stories.analysis: 模型新闻需要结合价格、延迟、上下文、工具调用和真实任务稳定性评估，单一榜单不足以判断产品竞争力。

stories.title: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
stories.summary: UP.Labs, now doing business under the name Vantora, is building startups for industrial corporations.

stories.title: The AI Superintelligence Slowdown
stories.summary: Remember when tech leaders would tell their employees to “move fast and break things”? It seemed that would be the way of AI too.

stories.title: Anthropic’s first embedded evaluator is … Accenture?
stories.summary: Accenture is about to take on its most high-risk consulting engagement ever.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于安全治理信号，后续重点是风险是否可量化、工具是否能落地、平台是否会跟进规则。

stories.title: Dario Amodei and other AI leaders want to ‘Pace the Frontier’ but…how?
stories.summary: A week after an Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning rattled the AI world, the company’s CEO Dario Amodei has outlined his plan to “pace the frontier” of AI development.
stories.analysis: 芯片、模型套件和 Agent 编排框架一起出现时，重点不是单点性能，而是端到端推理成本、部署效率和生态绑定。

stories.title: Gavin Newsom is pushing for an AI kill switch
stories.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom (D) is positioning the state to take the lead on AI oversight, including the potential to mandate a "kill switch" for frontier models, with a new executive order issued Friday.
stories.analysis: 前沿模型发布审查正在变成政府与实验室之间的制度问题，透明度不足会削弱外部对安全评估的信任。

stories.title: Automattic’s 33-Hour Coup, and can AI labs police themselves?

stories.title: A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers
stories.summary: Jev, a new kind of AI model, is showing developers a cheaper and faster path to software intelligence.
stories.analysis: AI 编程工具竞争正在进入大型迁移和多步骤修复场景，差异会体现在代码库理解、权限控制和可审计输出。

stories.title: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
stories.summary: Recently unsealed court documents in the New York Times' case against OpenAI and Microsoft are pretty damning.
stories.analysis: 版权诉讼的焦点正在从训练原则转向证据、数据集和输出归因，这会直接影响模型公司的合规成本与数据策略。

stories.title: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
stories.summary: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger ordered the state government to take steps that could empower local communities to have a larger say in data center development and slow down approvals in a state that is already home to the dat...
stories.analysis: 政府、国安和监管相关内容会影响模型公司的销售边界、合规成本和跨境可用性。

stories.title: Security researchers used Claude to help them hack into OpenAI
stories.summary: A team of three independent security researchers at Hacktron says it took less than 72 hours for them to hack into OpenAI employee accounts using Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.8 and 5, The Wall Street Journal reports.
stories.analysis: 安全与真实性议题正在从原则讨论进入可执行工具，媒体、平台和企业需要更快识别合成内容与自动化攻击。

stories.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
stories.summary: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于商业化信号，后续重点是它是否进入高频工作流，并形成稳定付费或留存。

stories.title: What Hollywood thinks about existential AI warnings
stories.summary: As the tech sector sounds alarms about AI's potential to destroy humanity, entertainment labor groups are urging the public to stay focused on what's already happening.

xTrends.signal: 模型能力、价格和开发者可用性是主要讨论点，很多帖子直接拿它和 OpenAI、Anthropic 对比。
讨论集中在新模型分层、企业访问节奏、推理质量和产品体验是否有实质提升。
安全研究者和 CISO 圈层关注 AI Agent 是否会把攻击链自动化到新的速度。
投资者讨论长期数据中心租约、电力容量和 AI 基建股是否进入过热区间。
手机厂商把 AI 拉回端侧入口之争，争议点是功能是否真能改变日常使用。
创作者圈层继续测试视频生成、图像模型和工作流自动化，版权与真实性问题伴随升温。

briefings.title: 从热度看真实优先级
briefings.text: 模型发布仍最容易引爆讨论，但企业最终会按稳定性、成本、权限集成和数据安全来选择供应商。

briefings.title: 安全窗口继续缩短
briefings.text: AI Agent 让攻击链更自动化，防守重点需要前移到身份、权限、工具调用和数据访问异常。

briefings.title: 资本开支影响模型竞争
briefings.text: 算力合同、芯片供应和数据中心成本正在成为 AI 公司竞争力的一部分。

watchlist: OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、NVIDIA 是否发布新的 API、价格或企业访问策略
X 高热讨论是否被主流媒体确认，还是停留在圈层争议
AI 数据中心和芯片供应是否出现新的融资、电力或交付约束
监管机构是否把 AI 安全、版权、金融建议或出口限制推进到执法层面
